content: Tanvi Saxena inquired about the 15-day post-expiry claim window, confirming with insurance agent Sunita Agarwal that services rendered on the policy expiry date (30/09/2026) are covered if filed within 15 days, and that services from 01/10/2026 onward fall under the renewed policy. Sunita also provided a digital copy of the updated policy via chat.

action_items: Customer to review the digital copy of the updated policy provided via link
